shared_elements: carved rock surface bearing low-relief curvilinear motifs
small circular depression suggesting an eye or cupule
justification: Both surfaces show shallow curvilinear relief on natural boulder faces, and in each a long hooked, beak-like arc paired with a small round eye-like hollow can be made out, which is a reasonably specific correspondence. However, A presents a dense, overlapping composition of several complete crouching beaked figures with bodies, arms and hands and multiple disc motifs, whereas B shows only a single faint arc and pit on an otherwise plain rock set in an empty seascape, so the combination, density and arrangement of depicted elements are largely incomparable.
